# Admin API

Everything the console and `apgctl` do, they do through this API. The machine-readable description is served at `/v1/openapi.json`.

- **Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are created under Settings in the console or with `apgctl tokens create`.
- **Workspaces:** `{ws}` is a workspace's id or name.
- **Lists:** `?limit=` (default 50, at most 500), `?cursor=`, `?name=`, `?label=key=value`. The answer is `{ data, next_cursor }`.
- **Concurrency:** a resource carries `ETag: "<revision>"`. Send `If-Match` with a write to refuse it when someone else changed the resource first (`412`).
- **Idempotency:** `PUT …/{name}` creates or replaces. `POST` honours an `Idempotency-Key` header for 24 hours.
- **Dry run:** `?dry_run=true` validates and returns the result without writing.
- **Errors:** `{ "error": { "code", "message", "request_id", "details": [{ "pointer", "message" }] } }`. See [error codes](error-codes.md).

## ca-certificates

| Method | Path | What it does | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/workspaces/{ws}/ca-certificates` | List ca-certificates | viewer |
| POST | `/v1/workspaces/{ws}/ca-certificates` | Create a ca_certificate | editor |
| DELETE | `/v1/workspaces/{ws}/ca-certificates/{ref}` | Delete a ca_certificate | editor |
| GET | `/v1/workspaces/{ws}/ca-certificates/{ref}` | Get a ca_certificate by id or name | viewer |
| PATCH | `/v1/workspaces/{ws}/ca-certificates/{ref}` | Patch a ca_certificate (JSON merge patch) | editor |
| PUT | `/v1/workspaces/{ws}/ca-certificates/{ref}` | Create or replace a ca_certificate (idempotent by name) | editor |

## config

| Method | Path | What it does | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/v1/config/apply` | Create and update what a document describes, atomically; never deletes | editor |
| POST | `/v1/config/diff` | Show what applying a document would change (add ?prune=true for what sync would also delete) | editor |
| GET | `/v1/config/dump` | Export a workspace as a document that sync accepts unchanged; secrets are placeholders | viewer |
| GET | `/v1/config/revisions` | Revisions of a workspace, newest first, and whether it has drifted from the newest | viewer |
| GET | `/v1/config/revisions/{id}` | One revision with its document; secrets are placeholders | viewer |
| POST | `/v1/config/revisions/{id}/rollback` | Apply a stored revision again, as a new revision | editor |
| POST | `/v1/config/sync` | As apply, and delete what the document omits | editor |
| POST | `/v1/config/validate` | Check a document without changing anything | editor |
